snapshot.text: Mainly public, tax-funded system rebuilding after decades of conflict, with large gaps in hospitals and medicines. The ministry is introducing digital health insurance and new hospitals; viral haemorrhagic fevers recur each year.

priorities.title: Digital health insurance
priorities.text: Iraq launched the Dhamani platform and digital health insurance services.

priorities.title: Ten new hospitals
priorities.text: The health ministry plans ten hospitals across the country.

priorities.title: Local production of cancer drugs
priorities.text: Iraq reports progress in local pharmaceutical production of cancer medicines.
